data.narrative:
Skapion is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $36M to date. The peer universe comprises five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables spanning Series A and Seed rounds, with a broader ecosystem of 10 total private comps and 2 public defense-tech peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). Leadership includes former XTEND and Rafael Advanced Defense Systems executives, including the ex-GM of Iron Dome and David's Sling programs.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to $36M total raised and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to Series A, implies $90M. Peer-median analysis across the five comparables yields $1.0B, with the peer set ranging from $125M (NODA AI, Series A) to $4.0B (Stark Defence, Series A).

Triangulating these methods produces a valuation range of $76M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $545M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around Skapion's commercial traction, product maturity, and addressable market capture relative to the peer set. Stage-progression implies a more conservative floor, while peer-median is anchored to later-stage rounds. Additional disclosure of revenue, customer concentration, and technical differentiation would narrow this range materially.
